_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6 object handlers: stage fortress $38 ($BA68-$BBF8). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): ride the scroll
regions.description: `JSR $BA51`.

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): first frame?
regions.description: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): Type bit 7 set goes to `$BAA2`. Table stats: collision flags `$6A`, hit points 128, attack 1, drawing flags `$10`, **dies as the block blast (type `$30`)**. A ground object made from the stage's metatiles. **All of what follows depends on the scroll (`$B7`, `$B9`); the run fed a constant scroll step of 1 px a frame, so the state sequence it showed is not the game's.**

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): loader counter
regions.description: `$0758` := 1 (the art wait below counts it down).

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): its own art block
regions.description: `LDA #$52 / JSR $C0AB` (`$CF68`): the art wait entered with the block number `$52` instead of the type's table entry.

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): area scaling
TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): y + 8
TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): picture
regions.description: Metasprite `$1A`.

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): palette
TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): state 0
TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): build length
regions.description: `$07D0` := `$BBE3[$B9]` (`64 96 C8 FA FA FA FA FA FA`: 100, 150, 200, 250 steps for the scroll speed's high byte `$B9` of 0, 1, 2 and more).

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): timer
TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): state
regions.description: State 0 goes to `$BAAE`, 1 to `$BAD6`, 2 and over to `$BB08`.

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): state 0: wait for y > `$40`
regions.description: `LDA #$40 / LDY #$3C / JSR $BBEC` (below): when the object's y is past 64 the timer becomes `$3C` and the state 1.

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): state 0: not yet
regions.description: Carry set returns.

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): state 0: the first picture
regions.description: `JSR $BF71`; a 2 x 2 tile block (`$BBBB`: `A1 A3 / AB AC`) is blitted at the cell (`$C07E` = `$D99C`) and sound `$41` plays.

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): state 1: wait for y > `$90` or 60 frames
regions.description: `LDA #$90 / LDY #$01 / JSR $BBEC`; if y is not past `$90`, the timer `$07A0` counts down and at zero the state becomes 2.

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): state 1 -> 2: the full picture
regions.description: The PPU address moves 2 tiles up and left (`$15` = `$14` = `$FE`, `$BBA3`), `JSR $BB80` draws the 6 x 3 block (`$BBBF`) and then a 6 x 2 block (`$BBD7`) is blitted below it.

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): state 2 or more
regions.description: State 2: waits for y of `$B0` (176) or more, then state 3. States 3 and over: `$0788` counts down.

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): steps left?
regions.description: `$07D0` zero: no more steps.

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): one step
regions.description: `$07D0` is decremented and the step timer `$0788` := 4 (1 when `$B9` is 2 or more).

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): rise or finish
regions.description: y under `$30`: the state goes back (`DEC $07B8`). Otherwise **y -= 8, the PPU address moves up a row (`$BBA3`) and the 6 x 4 block (`$BBBF`, `80 9D 9E 9E 9F 80 / 9D A1 A2 A2 A3 9F / A5 A6 A7 A8 A8 A9 / A5 20 20 20 20 A9`) is drawn again with sound `$41`: the structure climbs 8 px every 4 frames (every frame at speed 2 and over), `$07D0` times** - while the scroll carries it down. RUN (scroll step 1): steps of 8 px every 4 frames, 100 of them.

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): shot timer
regions.description: `$07A0` is decremented; non-zero skips the shot.

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): reload
regions.description: `$07A0` := `$28`: every 40 frames.

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): a free slot
TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): a homing bullet
regions.description: `LDA #$27 / JSR $C105`, heading `$0788,Y` := 4 (down).

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): bullet kind
regions.description: `$5C` (the scene number) = `$21`: kind 0 (palette 1, speed class 3, hit points 1, attack 4), otherwise kind 3 (palette 2, speed class 5, hit points 12, attack 64). RUN: 18 bullets in 900 frames, from frame 107, every 40.

regions.name: TYPE $38 (A STAGE FORTRESS THAT BUILDS ITSELF UP): draw, hit test, consequences
regions.description: `JSR $C090`, `JSR $C0CF`, `JMP $C0D2`.

regions.name: Fortress block drawers (`$BB80` / `$BB84`)
regions.description: `$BB80` height 3, `$BB84` height 4; width 6, the block `$BBBF`, drawn at y - `$18`, with sound `$41`.

regions.name: Fortress first picture (2 x 2 tiles)
regions.description: `A1 A3 / AB AC`.

regions.name: Fortress picture (6 x 4 tiles; the first 3 rows are the 6 x 3 block)
Fortress lower picture (6 x 2 tiles)
regions.description: `AA AB 20 20 AC AD / 80 AA AE AE AD 80`.

regions.name: Fortress build length by scroll speed
y past a line? (`$BBEC`)
regions.description: A = a y, Y = a timer: if the object's y is past A, `$07A0` := Y and the state `$07B8` is incremented (carry clear); otherwise carry set.
